title: Basic Attention Token rallies 20% as BAT’s trend turns bullish – What’s next?
summary: Long-term investors can wait for a price drop toward $0.10 or lower to look for an ideal buying opportunity to ride the trend upward.
content: Basic Attention Token recently rallied 20% as its market trend shifted to a bullish outlook. Market analysts note that long-term investors may want to wait for a potential price drop toward $0.10 or lower to find an ideal buying opportunity before riding the upward trend.

title: One year after 10/10, bitcoin and ether liquidity have rebuilt, but other altcoins still face risks
summary: Bitcoin and ether order books are deeper than before the crash, while altcoin liquidity keeps eroding and spot trading remains well below its October 2025 peak.
content: One year after the market crash, liquidity for Bitcoin and ether has successfully rebuilt, with order books showing deeper depth than before the event. However, other altcoins continue to face significant risks as their liquidity erodes, and overall spot trading volume remains well below its previous peak.

title: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
summary: Paxos Labs, Theo and Energy Substantiation execs see growth coming from putting physical assets to work, with precious metals leading and energy presenting a tougher test.
content: Tokenized commodities are expanding beyond traditional gold into new markets like lending and oil. Industry executives from Paxos Labs, Theo, and Energy Substantiation note that growth is driven by putting physical assets to work. While precious metals are leading this adoption, utilizing energy assets presents a more complex challenge for the market.

Paxos Labs, Theo மற்றும் Energy Substantiation நிறுவனங்களின் அதிகாரிகள், பௌதீக சொத்துக்களைப் பயன்படுத்துவதன் மூலம் வளர்ச்சி ஏற்படுவதாகக் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர். இதில் விலைமதிப்பற்ற உலோகங்கள் முன்னணியில் உள்ள போதிலும், எனர்ஜி சொத்துக்களைப் பயன்படுத்துவது சந்தைக்கு ஒரு கடினமான சவாலாக உள்ளது.

title: Justin Sun says Tron’s post-quantum cryptography has gone live on testnet
summary: “We’re ready to bring quantum resistance to mainnet at any time,” Sun said in a post on X.
content: Justin Sun announced that Tron has successfully launched its post-quantum cryptography on the testnet. Sun stated on social media that the network is fully prepared to introduce quantum resistance features to the mainnet at any given time.

title: Bitcoin's $19 billion wake-up call: One-year later, has crypto learned anything?
summary: One year after a flash crash wiped out billions in leveraged crypto bets, traders have better tools to spot risks. But the forces behind the selloff remain.
content: One year after a massive flash crash wiped out billions of dollars in leveraged Bitcoin bets, market participants now utilize better risk management tools. However, analysts note that the underlying structural forces and market vulnerabilities that triggered the sudden selloff still remain present in the cryptocurrency ecosystem today.
